paragraphs: Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc. (we, our, the Company or Vanda) is a leading global biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of innovative therapies to address high unmet medical needs and improve the lives of patients.

We strive to advance novel approaches to bring important new medicines to market through responsible innovation. We are committed to the use of technologies that support sound science, including genetics and genomics, in drug discovery, clinical trials and the commercial positioning of our products.

Our commercial portfolio is currently comprised of four products: Fanapt® for the acute treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder and the treatment of schizophrenia, HETLIOZ® for the treatment of Non-24-Hour Sleep-Wake Disorder (Non-24) and for the treatment of nighttime sleep disturbances in Smith-Magenis syndrome (SMS), PONVORY® for the treatment of relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (RMS) including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease and active secondary progressive disease and NEREUSTM for the prevention of vomiting induced by motion (collectively, our commercial products). HETLIOZ® is the first product approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for patients with Non-24 and for patients with SMS. In addition, we have a number of drugs and/or additional indications for current products in development, including:
•Fanapt® (iloperidone) long acting injectable (LAI) formulation for the treatment of schizophrenia and hypertension;

•BysantiTM (milsaperidone), the active metabolite of Fanapt®, for the acute treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder and for the treatment of schizophrenia and major depressive disorder (MDD);
•HETLIOZ® (tasimelteon) for the treatment of jet lag disorder, insomnia, pediatric insomnia, delayed sleep phase disorder (DSPD) and pediatric Non-24;
•PONVORY® (ponesimod) for the treatment of psoriasis and ulcerative colitis;
•NEREUSTM (tradipitant) for the prevention of vomiting induced by GLP-1 receptor agonists, the treatment of gastroparesis and the treatment of atopic dermatitis;
•Imsidolimab, an IL-36R antagonist, for the treatment of generalized pustular psoriasis (GPP);
•VTR-297, a small molecule histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitor for the treatment of hematologic malignancies and onychomycosis and with potential use as a treatment for several oncology indications;

•Portfolio of Cystic Fibrosis Transmembrane Conductance Regulator (CFTR) activators and inhibitors, including VSJ-110 for the treatment of dry eye and ocular inflammation and VPO-227 for the treatment of secretory diarrhea disorders, including cholera;
•VQW-765, a small molecule alpha-7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor partial agonist, for the treatment of social/performance anxiety and psychiatric disorders; and

•Antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) molecules, including VCA-894A for the treatment of Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease, Type 2S (CMT2S), caused by cryptic slice site variants within the IGHMBP2 gene and VGT-1849A for the treatment of polycythemia vera (PV), a form of a rare hematologic malignancy.
We were incorporated in 2002 and commenced operations in 2003. We are headquartered in Washington, D.C.

headings: Risks Related to our Business and Industry

We are dependent on the commercial success of our commercial products. In the U.S., HETLIOZ® competes with generic versions of HETLIOZ® and we could experience increased generic competition in the near term.
If the FDA does not approve our NDA filing for the use of NEREUSTM for patients with gastroparesis, our business may be harmed, and the market price of our stock could decline.
We might not obtain the necessary regulatory approvals to commercialize current product candidates, including BysantiTM and imsidolimab.
Global economic conditions may have an adverse effect on our business.
Our business may be materially adversely affected by the imposition of duties and tariffs and other trade barriers and retaliatory countermeasures implemented by the U.S. and other governments.
Global health crises and pandemics may adversely impact our business.
We rely on, and will continue to rely on, outsourcing arrangements for many of our activities, including preclinical and clinical development and supply of our commercial and other products.
Disruptions to our commercial products' supply chains could materially affect our level of success in commercializing these products, thereby reducing our future earnings and prospects.
paragraphs: Our business, financial condition and operating results can be affected by a number of factors, whether currently known or unknown, including but not limited to those described below, any one or more of which could, directly or indirectly, cause our actual operating results and financial condition to vary materially from past, or anticipated future, operating results and financial condition. Any of these factors, in whole or in part, could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, operating results and the price of our common stock.

The following discussion of risk factors contains forward-looking statements. These risk factors may be important to understanding any statement in this annual report on Form 10-K (Annual Report) or elsewhere. The following information should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes in Part II, Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data and Part II, Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.

Because of the following risk factors, as well as other risk factors affecting our financial condition and operating results, past financial performance should not be considered to be a reliable indicator of future performance, and investors should not use historical trends to anticipate results or trends in future periods.

We are substantially dependent upon the commercial success of Fanapt® oral tablets for the acute treatment of mixed or manic episodes associated with bipolar I disorder and the treatment of schizophrenia, HETLIOZ® capsules for the treatment of Non-24-Hour Sleep-Wake Disorder (Non-24), HETLIOZ® capsules and oral suspension (HETLIOZ LQ®) for the treatment of nighttime sleep disturbances in Smith-Magenis syndrome (SMS), PONVORY® oral tablets for the treatment of relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (RMS) in adults and NEREUSTM capsules for the prevention of vomiting induced by motion.

In the fourth quarter of 2014, we acquired the U.S. commercial rights to Fanapt®, and began selling, marketing and distributing Fanapt® in the U.S. for the treatment of schizophrenia in adults. On April 2, 2024, the FDA approved Fanapt® tablets for the acute treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder in adults. We initiated the commercial launch of Fanapt® for the acute treatment of bipolar I disorder in adults in the third quarter of 2024.

In January 2014, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved our New Drug Application (NDA) for HETLIOZ® for the treatment of Non-24 and in April 2014, we commenced the U.S. commercial launch of HETLIOZ®. In July 2015, the European Commission (EC) granted centralized marketing authorization with unified labeling for HETLIOZ® for the treatment of Non-24 in totally blind adults, and in August 2016 we commenced the commercial launch of HETLIOZ® in Germany. This authorization, which was renewed in July 2020 for an unlimited duration, is valid in the 27 countries that are members of the European Union (E.U.), as well as European Economic Area members Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway. In December 2020, the FDA approved our NDA and supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) for HETLIOZ® for the treatment of nighttime sleep disturbances in SMS in adults and children, respectively. HETLIOZ® capsules, for adults with SMS, were immediately available after approval and the HETLIOZ LQ® liquid formulation, for children with SMS, became available in March 2021.

paragraphs: Vanda Pharmaceuticals Inc. (we, our, the Company or Vanda) 為一全球領先的生技藥品公司，專注於開發與商業化創新療法，以解決高需求的醫療問題，並改善病患的生活品質。
我們致力於透過負責任的創新，推動新穎的治療方式，將重要的新藥帶入市場。我們承諾使用支持科學研究的技術，包括遺傳學與基因組學，用於藥物研發、臨牀試驗以及我們產品的商業定位。

目前，我們的商業產品組合包含四種產品：Fanapt® 用於治療雙極 I 型障礙所伴隨的躁動或混合發作，以及治療精神分裂症；HETLIOZ® 用於治療非 24 小時睡眠-清醒障礙（Non-24）以及治療史密斯-馬根尼斯症候羣（SMS）的夜間睡眠障礙；PONVORY® 用於治療多發性硬化症（RMS）的復發型形式，包括臨牀孤立症、復發-緩解型疾病以及活動性二次進展型疾病；NEREUSTM 用於預防因運動所引起的嘔吐（ collectively, 我們的商業產品）。HETLIOZ® 是美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）首個核准用於 Non-24 患者及 SMS 患者的產品。此外，我們有數種藥物及/或現有產品的其他適應症正在開發中，包括：
•Fanapt® (iloperidone) 長效注射劑（LAI）用於治療精神分裂症及高血壓；
•BysantiTM (milsaperidone)，為 Fanapt® 的活性代謝物，用於治療雙極 I 型障礙所伴隨的躁動或混合發作，以及治療精神分裂症及重大抑鬱症（MDD）；
•HETLIOZ® (tasimelteon) 用於治療時差症候羣、失眠、兒童失眠、延遲睡眠相位症候羣（DSPD）及兒童 Non-24；
•PONVORY® (ponesimod) 用於治療銀屑病及潰瘍性結腸炎；
•NEREUSTM (tradipitant) 用於預防因 GLP-1 受體激動劑引起的嘔吐，治療胃輕癱及治療過敏性皮膚炎；
•Imsidolimab，一項 IL-36R 抗體，用於治療 generalized pustular psoriasis (GPP)；
•VTR-297，一項小分子 histone deacetylase (HDAC) 抑制劑，用於治療血液腫瘤及 onychomycosis，並有潛在用於治療多種腫瘤指徵的可能；
•囊性纖維化跨膜導電調節器 (CFTR) 激活劑及抑制劑組合，包括 VSJ-110 用於治療乾眼症及眼部發炎，以及 VPO-227 用於治療分泌性腹瀉症候羣，包括霍亂；
•VQW-765，一項小分子 alpha-7 菸鹼型乙酰膽鹼受體部分活化劑，用於治療社交/表現焦慮及精神疾病；以及
•反義核酸 (ASO) 分子，包括 VCA-894A 用於治療 Charcot-Marie-Tooth 疾病，Type 2S (CMT2S)，由 IGHMBP2 基因內的 cryptic slice site 變異所引起，以及 VGT-1849A 用於治療 polycythemia vera (PV)，一種罕見的血液腫瘤形式。
我們於 2002 年成立，並於 2003 年開始營運。我們的總部設於華盛頓特區。

headings: 與本公司業務及產業相關之風險
我們依賴商業產品之商業成功。在美國，HETLIOZ® 會與 HETLIOZ® 之仿製藥競爭，我們可能在近期面臨增加之仿製藥競爭。
若美國食品藥物管理局未批准我們針對 NEREUSTM 用於胃輕癱患者之新藥申請（NDA）文件，將可能對本公司業務造成損害，並導致本公司股票市場價格下跌。
我們可能無法取得必要的監管核准，以商業化目前之產品候選藥物，包括 BysantiTM 及 imsidolimab。
全球經濟情勢可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司業務可能因美國及其他政府所實施之關稅與貿易壁壘及報復性反制措施而受到重大不利影響。
全球健康危機與疫情可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
我們依賴，並將持續依賴委外合作關係，以執行許多活動，包括臨牀前與臨牀開發，以及商業及其他產品之供應。

paragraphs: 本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能受多項因素影響，無論是否已知或未知，包括但不限於下列所列，任何一項或數項因素，可能直接或間接導致本公司實際營運成果與財務狀況與過去或預期未來之營運成果與財務狀況有重大差異。上述任何因素，全數或部分，可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果及普通股之價格產生重大且不利之影響。
以下有關風險因素之討論包含前瞻性陳述。這些風險因素可能對理解本年度報告表10-K（年度報告）或其它地方之任何陳述具有重要性。以下資訊應與第二部分，項目8，財務報表及補充資料，以及第二部分，項目7，管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析與討論，所附之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。
由於下列風險因素，以及其它影響本公司財務狀況與營運成果之風險因素，過去之財務表現不應視為未來表現之可靠指標，投資人亦不應以歷史趨勢預測未來期間之結果或趨勢。

本公司極度依賴 Fanapt® 口服片劑之商業成功，用以治療與雙極I型障礙相關之混合或躁動發作，以及治療精神分裂症；HETLIOZ® 膠囊用以治療非24小時睡眠-清醒障礙（Non-24）；HETLIOZ® 膠囊及口服懸浮液（HETLIOZ LQ®）用以治療史密斯-馬根尼斯症候羣（SMS）之夜間睡眠障礙；PONVORY® 口服片劑用以治療成人之多發性硬化症（RMS）之復發型；NEREUSTM 膠囊用以預防由運動所引起之嘔吐。
2014年第四季，本公司取得 Fanapt® 在美國之商業權利，並開始在美國銷售、推廣及分銷 Fanapt® 用以治療成人之精神分裂症。2024年4月2日，美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准 Fanapt® 片劑用以治療與雙極I型障礙相關之急性躁動或混合發作於成人。本公司於2024年第三季啟動 Fanapt® 用以治療成人雙極I型障礙之商業發售。

2014年1月，美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准本公司之新藥申請（NDA）用以治療Non-24之HETLIOZ®，並於2014年4月啟動HETLIOZ®在美國之商業發售。2015年7月，歐盟委員會（EC）授予HETLIOZ®於治療完全失明成人之Non-24之集中行銷授權，並具統一標籤，2016年8月本公司啟動HETLIOZ®在德國之商業發售。此授權於2020年7月重獲批准，並無期限，適用於歐盟（E.U.）27個成員國，以及歐洲經濟區成員國冰島、列支敦士登及挪威。2020年12月，FDA批准本公司之NDA及補充新藥申請（sNDA）用以治療SMS成人及兒童之夜間睡眠障礙。HETLIOZ®膠囊，用以治療成人SMS，於批准後立即可供使用，而HETLIOZ LQ®液體配方，用以治療兒童SMS，則於2021年3月可供使用。
